method: Independent fresh BulletTaskEnvironment reset and exact replay of all ten recorded Astra decisions. Camera resolution 64 during audit; physics unchanged. Evaluator-only contacts sampled after each control step.

contact_evidence.interpretation: Both fingers contact the rising object at every sampled step from first closure through goal crossing. This supports grasped transport rather than a ballistic threshold crossing. Contacts are sampled per control step, not every internal physics substep. Forces reflect this simulator setup, not physical-robot realism.

limitations: Success terminates immediately on the first threshold crossing. No post-success hold, release, stable placement, or broader success-rate claim is established. Task/controller/cameras differ from the ten-task baseline, so this is not a controlled simulator comparison.
